text.ko: 업종 평균 수준. 강점: 총자산이익률(ROA) 11.6%. 약점: 잉여현금흐름 마진 16.6%.
text.en: About average for its sector. Strength: Return on assets 11.6%. Weakness: Free cash flow margin 16.6%.

text.en: Weak within its sector. Strength: 3-yr free cash flow growth 23.5%. Weakness: 3-yr EPS growth (annual) -6.2%.

text.ko: 업종 내 우수. 강점: EV/EBITDA 14.34x. 약점: PEG(성장 대비 PER) 적자/음수 · n/m.

text.en: The current economy tends to work against this sector. Main factor: rising rates (hurts).
